speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this persistent cough and breathlessness, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about six weeks now, and the breathlessness has been getting worse lately, especially when I try to walk up stairs. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to left ventricular dysfunction causing pulmonary congestion).
